meta.name: quality-assessment
meta.description: Evaluate ENCODE experiment quality using standard metrics and audit flags. Use when the user asks about data quality, wants to filter for high-quality experiments, needs to interpret quality metrics (FRiP, NSC, RSC, NRF, IDR, TSS enrichment, fragment size), wants to understand ENCODE audit warnings, needs to compare quality across experiments, or is deciding whether data is usable for their analysis. Also use when the user mentions QC, quality control, or data filtering.

copy.tagline: 评估ENCODE实验数据质量，解读QC指标与审计标记。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理ENCODE数据，需要快速判断实验是否可用。
